slot.brief: Show/verify which of the statement forms (~(p∧q)) → r, (p→r)∨(q→r) etc. are logically equivalent by truth table or algebraic manipulation; pick the equivalent pair.

stem: Which pair of propositions is logically equivalent for all truth values of $p,q,r$?

verdicts.working: In (A), ¬(p∧q)→r ≡ ¬¬(p∧q)∨r ≡ (p∧q)∨r, matching the second proposition. The other pairs are not equivalent.
